verdict.rationale: New Relic ships official first-party agents/SDKs for Go, Java, .NET, Node.js, PHP, Python, and Ruby, plus a GraphQL-based NerdGraph API with an interactive API explorer, OpenTelemetry instrumentation support, and an official CLI (newrelic-cli), giving developers multiple official, documented ways to build against the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of SDK developer experience and no explicit AI-native SDK features (e.g., no OpenAPI spec found, llms.txt 404).
